verifications.claim: The "No Kings" protests are a series of nationwide, peaceful rallies in the United States.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "‘No Kings’ protests take place nationwide" (R1); "peacefully mobilized millions of people to take to the streets" (R2); "Throngs of demonstrators gathered in cities across the country" (R3); "over 3,000 local events" (R6); "Protesters took to the streets in cities across the U.S." (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe the protests as nationwide, peaceful, and occurring across US cities, towns, and states.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: March 28, 2026 — ‘No Kings’ protests take place nationwide (R1 title); "third round of “No Kings” protests" on March 28, 2026 (R3); "third “No Kings” demonstrations" March 28, 2026 (R4); "March 28, 2026 at 3PM" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources dated 2026 explicitly report on the third iteration of protests occurring in March 2026.

verifications.claim: The "No Kings" protests aimed at opposing the policies of the Trump administration.

verifications.evidence: "rallying against President Donald Trump’s policies" (R1); "protests against the Trump administration" (R3); "protest President Trump’s policies" (R4); "opposition to Trump’s attempt to rule" (R6); "oppose the policies of President Trump" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly state opposition to Trump administration policies.
